beats.summary: Andy performs in the play Sweeney Todd and invites coworkers to attend the closing night.

evidence.snippet: Andy: We're the cast of Sweeney Todd:
Andy: You all made it, thank you so much.

beats.summary: Michael struggles with not being cast in the play and initially refuses to attend.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I wish I could, Andy, but I can't. I have plans that night.

beats.summary: Dwight and Angela negotiate attendance at the play based on their contractual agreement.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Alright, fine. I'll go to your little show, but I'm not wearing a cape.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam want to attend but face babysitting issues; Erin agrees to babysit.
